extraction.Name: Henry Chapman
extraction.Recorded patent: Filed for record by allottee; receipted for yes
extraction.Buyer: not stated; land sold for about $1800 through foreclosure
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Taxes paid by allottee while he held the land; allottee was forced to sell his land for the mortgage
extraction.Occupation/Income: Allottee has interest in two restricted allotments, from which he receives about $35 per annum. Shares in Pawnee annuity.
extraction.NOTES: Wife and five minor children dependent upon allottee for support. Good health. No other property accumulated. Owing to the fact that the allottee was forced to sell his land for the mortgage, he feels that he did not receive what it was worth, especially considering the oil play that was developing in the vicinity of his land. Has any of the land been sold for debt or taxes — Pawnee County, Okla.
